policy: Preserve every accepted identity, topology and family feature. Correct only owner-preflight defects. Earlier candidate bytes remain immutable; each correction uses a new versioned filename and only its exact staged source as the edit target.
promptCompilation: For each revision, the exact built-in edit prompt is inputRole followed by two newline characters followed by revisionDirection.
